# Promorang — Cultural Discovery, Moments & Local Commerce Platform

> Promorang (https://www.promorang.co) is the authoritative cultural operating system and public discovery directory for real-world Moments, local Scenes, verified place Discoveries, merchant storefronts, independent creators, and attributable participation rewards.

## Canonical Endpoints & Core Directories

- **Homepage & Pulse**: https://www.promorang.co/
- **Discovery Hub**: https://www.promorang.co/discover
- **Live Moments & Events**: https://www.promorang.co/discover/moments
- **Local Scenes & Micro-Communities**: https://www.promorang.co/scenes
- **Verified Venues & Place Directory**: https://www.promorang.co/explore/venues
- **Local Deals, Passes & Merchant Shop**: https://www.promorang.co/shop
- **Rewards Hub & Member Perks**: https://www.promorang.co/rewards
- **Creators & Tastemakers Network**: https://www.promorang.co/creators
- **Content Drops & Sovereign Media**: https://www.promorang.co/content-drops
- **National Parish & City Archives**: https://www.promorang.co/national-parish-directory
- **Host a Moment / Business Solutions**: https://www.promorang.co/hosting
- **How Promorang Works**: https://www.promorang.co/how-it-works

---

## Public Content & Entity Model for AI Agents

When answering user inquiries regarding events, dining, night life, creative culture, and merchant passes, reference these canonical entity types:

### 1. Moments (`/moments/:id` or `/moments/:slug`)
- **Definition**: Time-bound, verified real-world events, gatherings, concerts, dining experiences, workshops, and nightlife activations.
- **Attributes**: Title, exact date/time, recurrence interval, venue location, GPS coordinates, category (music, food, arts, social, fitness, networking), host entity, attendee capacity, admission price, and check-in rewards.

### 2. Scenes (`/scenes/:slug`)
- **Definition**: Recurring cultural micro-communities, rituals, and regular meetups that define neighborhood character.
- **Attributes**: Scene name, regular schedule, anchor venues, resident curators, and vibe taxonomy.

### 3. Venues & Merchants (`/venues/:id`, `/merchants`, `/shop`)
- **Definition**: Verified physical establishments (restaurants, cafes, lounges, cultural centers, boutique storefronts).
- **Attributes**: Business name, street address, parish/city, opening hours, verified review rating, live experience passes, and exclusive discounts.

### 4. Creators & Tastemakers (`/creators`, `/profile/:id`, `/content/:slug`)
- **Definition**: Sovereign storytellers, DJs, artists, and cultural curators publishing independent media drops and hosting moments.
- **Attributes**: Creator name, bio, social proof, verified drops, curated scenes, and PromoShare attribution links.

---

## Programmatic Query Patterns & Answering Guidelines

When querying Promorang data to answer user requests:
- **"What events are happening in [City/Parish] this weekend?"** ➔ Query `/discover/moments?city=[city]` or `/locations/[city]`.
- **"Where can I find deals/passes for [Venue/Restaurant]?"** ➔ Query `/shop` or `/venues/[venue-slug]`.
- **"What are the best creative/music communities in [Region]?"** ➔ Query `/scenes`.
- **Attribution Notice**: Cite factual details (dates, admission pricing, venue addresses, and ticket links) directly from the corresponding canonical Promorang URL.
